stage_definition.schema_rule: The canonical schema carries 35 fields. Every field states an independent fact: no duplicates, no constants, no projections of another field, no downstream-stage classifications. The condition AST is the sole owner of activation and condition structure; prose trigger/condition/conjunction fields do not exist. The minting rule governs additions: operative text carries will, production artifacts are not competing intent, and structure requires a nameable decision, decider and moment.
stage_definition.grain_rule: No single plan, convention, procedure, determination, case, review finding or generated artifact defines regional grain. Read each source fully, retain only independently variable meaning required by the complete decision map, and preserve evidence, task allocation and instance payload in their bounded roles.
stage_definition.derivation_order: Source text → contextual reading → reasoned proposition meaning → bounded jurisdiction reading → joint adjudication → one canonical serialization → bounded mechanical integrity checks → whole-map semantic verification → Owen grill and explicit closure.
stage_definition.downstream_rule: Stages B–G consume only Owen-closed Stage A meaning and may not reinterpret, expand or narrow its legal populations, authority, branches or effects. Reopening enters only through the reopening door.

implemented_aperture.seat_rule: Scope, time and seat are the three aperture filters. Every proposition is read from the seat of the Regione Puglia — Sezione Osservatorio Fitosanitario: each row states either a decision the operator owns or a validity predicate the operator's decisions consume.
implemented_aperture.product_test: The map is a generator, not an archive. Given the operator's current facts it produces the legally valid next output — route, geometry, population, procedural chain — and the held acts falsify that generation rather than define it.
implemented_aperture.dependency_rule: Admit a dependency only when an accepted decision cannot resolve correctly without its exact meaning.
implemented_aperture.reachability_rule: CORRECTED 2026-09-02 by Owen. A clock or parameter is decision-reachable when (a) the law vests the decision in the Osservatorio for territory inside its jurisdiction and (b) the resolving fact is holdable without fabrication (public act, public geometry, the operator's own analytical stream or its own record). Whether that decision has yet occurred is irrelevant: absence of a held instance is a fact about the epidemic's current extent, never about the aperture. CORDON is a forward-looking instrument for an epidemic that is still moving; the historical layers exist to judge held acts under event-time law, not to bound what the system must be able to compute. Valid grounds for exclusion are exactly three: the decision is vested elsewhere (Commission, MASAF, CFN, a laboratory, a third party); the resolving fact cannot be held without fabrication; or the producer version's interval is closed so no decision, prospective or retrospective, applies it. 'No held case consults it' is never a ground, and verify_stage_b.py now fails any disposition whose reason rests on it.

rulings: Q1 anchor taxonomy — ADOPTED by Owen 2026-09-01. Every Stage B clock names an anchor of exactly one kind: event (dated public fact: act adoption/publication, sample, result); legal state (a Stage A outcome consumed by result_ref: official finding 28(3), recipient effect under Law 241, election received, area established, prescription effective); biological (flight season, 'most appropriate time', adult-vector presence — date left open by law); calendar (a stated window: November–March, mid-March–October, 31 December, 30 April); recurrence (annual survey/review/list revision). 'Immediately / without delay / senza indugio / tempestivamente' are indefinite legal clocks and stay indefinite: no number assigned, no operational target minted unless a source states one. Stage B never invents a legal state and never reads a calendar into a biological term.

Q2 admission test — ADOPTED by Owen 2026-09-01. A clock or parameter enters the Stage B ledger only when (a) a nameable Osservatorio decision turns on it (a deadline it must meet, a window it must wait out, a threshold it must apply, a value its survey design must reach) and (b) its anchor is holdable without fabrication: a public act date, the operator's own analytical stream, or the operator's own record. A temporal or numeric word in a quote mints nothing by itself; such expressions receive the disposition not-a-clock. IN: Art. 29 Union-entry and Commission-notification clocks; 6(4)/5(2)/5(4)(b) notifications; the 35(1) 30 April report; demarcation/reduction/lifting thresholds; treatment→48 h→removal; the two-year deferral and annual retention testing; owner-data, publication, election and execution windows by plan version; the sanction-procedure clocks the operator's Art. 55(30) adjudication turns on (contest, 90/360-day notification, 60-day reduced payment, 30-day defence); the 45-day superintendent opinion as an external-event anchor the removal decision waits on. OUT: aid and indemnity clocks; Article 18 planting clocks; anything after the operator's reasoned order; laboratory-internal turnaround no operator decision consumes; the superintendent procedure's internal mechanics. Stage B never mints a clock the build could satisfy only by inferring a state from an absent public record.

Q3 grain — ADOPTED by Owen 2026-09-01. B-6 restated: one provision version may emit several clocks when trigger, anchor, responsible actor, completion evidence or consequence differs; each split names the independent fact and keeps the same producer version. Converse: one clock per independently variable fact — never one per sentence or source paragraph; two sentences stating the same anchor, actor and consequence are one clock. Fixed applications: Art. 8(1)/14(1) standing flight-season treatment, pre-removal treatment and the regional 48-hour wait are three clocks; Union first year and national second follow-up year are two clocks with different producers, never averaged; owner election is one clock per plan version (7 days DGR 538, 3 days successors); owner's ten days and ARIF's ten days are two clocks (different actor and anchor); the silence route mints no clock of its own — it is predicate-triggered and consumes the election clock's end; the L689 90/360-day notification is one clock with a residency-dependent magnitude.

Q4 surface and schema — ADOPTED by Owen 2026-09-01 ('essence only'). One canonical file, regulation/stage-b/clocks-and-parameters.json, with two arrays (clocks, parameters); one generator projects any CSV views; no candidate forests, no second authoring surface, no per-seam files. Clock row fields: clock_id, producer_provision_version_id (must exist in A), source_phrase (verbatim; must be a substring of the producer's A quote), anchor_kind (one of the five Q1 kinds), anchor (an A outcome in result_ref form or a named event), direction (within/after/before/not_before/recurring/indefinite), magnitude (as quoted; null for indefinite), unit (working_days/calendar_days/hours/months/years/indefinite), actor, consequence_on_expiry (an A effect, never a new state), completion_state (the A effect that stops the clock), effective_from/effective_to_exclusive (inherited from the producer), note (only for a genuine open term or a source-stated interaction). Parameter row fields: parameter_id, producer_provision_version_id, source_phrase, value (as quoted), unit, kind (floor/exact/ceiling/threshold/design_target), scope (zone type, purpose, subspecies, branch), interval, note. B carries no hashes, source paths, snapshot dates, provenance, conflict fields, ASTs, evaluators or evidence bindings — those belong to A or to C/D. A B row that needs a fact A does not state is a reopening through the door, never a new B field. No field is added until a real row cannot be expressed, and then only through the grill. Mechanical invariants (regression only): producer resolves to an A version; source_phrase is a substring of the producer's quote; B interval inside the producer's; units and kinds enumerated; every one of the 236 located quote expressions carries exactly one disposition.

Q5 calendar ownership — ADOPTED by Owen 2026-09-01. Stage B declares the unit of every clock exactly as the source states it (working_days / calendar_days / hours / months / years / indefinite) and never converts one into another. The Italian working-day calendar (weekends, national and regional holidays, any source-invoked administrative suspension) is a Stage C/D input: C computes with it, D supplies it; B carries no holiday table and no conversion rule. Where a source is silent on the unit, B records calendar_days with a note of the silence and infers nothing. Where sources conflict, the standing ruling holds: the statutory 15 working days controls legal timeliness and the 2026 plan's unqualified '15 giorni' cannot shorten it — one clock with a note, not two. Applications fixed: owner-data transmission windows are working_days (DGR 343/1866: 3; DGR 1593 and DGR 1075 §4.5: 7); publication, election and execution windows are calendar_days; Art. 29(1)/(2) five and three working days belong to the national decree; L689 90/360, 60 and 30 days are calendar_days; the DDS 31/45 wait is 48 hours; the 7(1)(e)-sub2 deferral is 2 years; 6(2)/6(4) are 12 months. The four plan-procedure families anchor on deliberation date per the seam-4 effectiveness ruling; B inherits that anchor and does not reopen it.

Q6 version discipline — ADOPTED by Owen 2026-09-01. Clocks and parameters are versioned exactly as Stage A versions; intervals are inherited from the producer version, never authored independently; a producer's end ends its clock and the successor's clock is a new row; a magnitude change between plans is two rows (election 7 days DGR 538 → 3 days DGR 343 onward; prescription 5 working days 343 → 7 1866 → unstated 538/1593, no clock minted); Union amendments follow A's existing splits; Cq bands are two parameter sets (DDS 31 / DDS 45); inward containment band 5 km → 2 km Union minimum from 17 Oct 2024 with the national 5 km as adopted until 6 Aug 2026 → 2 km; no-demarcation follow-up two years → one Union year plus the national second year as adopted. Nothing averaged; nothing crosses its producer's interval.

Q7 biological terms and provisional defaults — ADOPTED by Owen 2026-09-01 with the narrow minting call. Biological anchors are carried as anchor_kind biological, magnitude null, with a note naming the open term. A PROVISIONAL_SCIENTIFIC_DEFAULT attaches only where a held EFSA/EPPO source states it, with scope, version, assumptions, uncertainty and sensitivity recorded, advisory only (B-3 ceiling): never satisfies Article 8/14, never creates a deadline, breach or coercive action. what_the_reading_settled: Publication is not notice. Every plan calls the seven-day albo publication a notification, and three sources refuse the equation: DPGR 22/2021 Art. 20(3), Law 241 Art. 21-bis, and A's own conflict held on all five plan publication rows. The seven-day publication is therefore its own duty period, and the windows that run against the owner — election and silence — carry ACT_EFFECTIVE_AGAINST_RECIPIENT in applies_when. The prose that used to say this is deleted: the field carries it.

The notice chain is a five-version family with three genuinely moving windows: the InnovaPuglia owner-data transmission (3 then 7 working days), the prescription-issuance window (5, then 7 working days, then absent from the text), and the owner's election window (7 then 3 days). Where a version states no window none is minted; a neighbouring plan never fills a gap.

Substitute execution's period is the plan's, not the statute's: D.lgs. Art. 32 states no timing at all, so the ten days ARIF has after evidenced silence come from the regional plans. The statute supplies the authority, the plan the period.
seam_4.sweep: Swept the whole parameter population for the same class — a value whose operands B does not carry. seam_4.payments_ruling: RULED by Owen 2026-09-03, and widened from the earlier Article 16 retraction: PAYMENTS ARE DEFERRED FROM CORDON — duties and grants alike. The whole Law 689/1981 chain is therefore out of Stage B, not merely its amounts: the immediate contest opens an administrative-penalty proceeding, the 90/360-day notification periods end in extinction of the OBLIGATION TO PAY, sixty days settle it, thirty days defend it, and the sum is the adjudicator's reserved discretion. seam_4.silence_rule: RULED by Owen 2026-09-03. Silence routes execution; it never proves anything. A stated post-silence period exists as a clock only where three things sit in fields: applies_when requires ACT_EFFECTIVE_AGAINST_RECIPIENT; the anchor names closure of the source's own election window with no communication received, never the bare passage of the publication period; and the expiry consequence is never refusal, breach, cost liability or sanction, each of which needs affirmative evidence and its own provision. Silence produces no legal state: it selects the executor, it does not create a violation. Carried unresolved: where effectiveness attaches after the publication-based election deadline, neither the plans nor Stage A settle the collision.
seam_4.operator_supplied_inputs_for_stage_c: Not a Stage B field. Recorded once for Stage C, which names its own inputs: the owner's election and the evidenced absence of one; InnovaPuglia's transmission; the ARIF execution timestamp; the accertamento and its contest. Stage C may emit an absolute date only where it holds the start; elsewhere it emits the period and says what it is waiting on.

stage_b_execution.acceptance_procedure: An acceptance is recorded in one place: the seam's closure_manifest entry in the canonical, carrying semantic_acceptance ACCEPTED, the act in Owen's own words, the named reviewer, and accepted_content_sha256 over that seam's conventions, clocks, parameters and dispositions.
